payload.name: Mysterious Shrine
payload.description: You discover an ancient shrine covered in moss. Strange runes glow faintly in the dappled light. Do you dare approach?

success.description: The shrine pulses with warm light. You feel the blessing of a forgotten god wash over you.

failure.description: The runes flare angrily. Dark energy lashes out!

success.description: You decipher the ancient text and discover a hidden compartment!

failure.description: The runes make no sense to you. You move on.

choices.description: Wisdom is knowing when not to touch ancient magic.

authority: Custom Crown campaign event, not an SRD trap/NPC/spell replacement
occurrence_policy: Table may roll again; same in-flight occurrence must not reroll/reapply on reopen. Campaign-specific uniqueness beyond generated room claims is unresolved, not silently global once-per-event-ID.
